# Registered suspects by group, 2011 reporting year (fixture, outdated)

> **FIXTURE — not a real source.** Written for the test suite. The numbers illustrate a structure; they are not evidence about the world.

Reporting year 2011. The table gives registered suspects per 100,000 residents by
population group for that year. The recording rules changed in a later revision and the
series is not directly comparable with more recent editions. The document contains no
adjustment and no discussion of the difference between suspects and convictions.
